title: DiagnosticEvent
description: One diagnostic event about the stack's own behavior: a process lifetime of a session, a headless run, a gate verdict, a sprint evaluation, a compaction, a projection-cost measurement, a retrieval miss. Session events are written into .council/diagnostics.jsonl by the council's session diagnostics hooks and their backfill command, one per non-empty process lifetime that has ended (settled or interrupted); run, crew and gate events are derived by the archivist from auto-mate run records; all are copied into index/diagnostics/events-<YYYY-MM>.jsonl. Never contains prompt or response bodies. See decisions/ADR-0006-diagnostics.md and its amendment A1.

schema_version.description: 1.1 adds lifetime, cost_state_usage_by_model and counts.tool_failures_by_tool; a 1.0 event carries none of them. A kind=session event must be 1.1; other kinds may stay 1.0.

event_id.description: UUID; the deduplication key when events are copied into the index. For kind=session: UUIDv5 in namespace 5f0c2b8e-2a7d-4d38-9a51-1c2f1d6e2006 over 'session-lifetime|<session_id>|<lifetime.anchor>', so every observer of a lifetime writes the same id.

ts.description: When the measured thing ended, UTC. For kind=session: the latest timestamp among the lifetime's own entries, main transcript or subagent files, never the hook's clock.

kind.description: What the event measures. session: one process lifetime of one session that has ended, either settled (its closing cost-state exists; outcome ended) or interrupted (none was written; outcome interrupted); schema 1.1. Its measures are deltas over that lifetime, and a session's total is the sum of its events, never its latest event.

project.description: Repository name as listed in workspace/repos.json.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id; the join key across audit entries, transcripts, run records and OTel.

parent_session_id.description: For a headless crew or gate: the session that invoked automate, when known. A session event's fork and /clear links are in lifetime.

run_path.description: Path of the persisted run record this event was derived from.

sprint.description: Sprint context at the end of the measured thing, from .harness/sprint-state.json. For kind=session, lifetime.sprint_at_start holds the start.

agent_name.description: Subagent or gate name when the event is about one agent.

head.description: Commit sha at the end of the measured thing.

usage.description: For kind=session: the lifetime's own requests, each requestId once, over the main transcript and the session's subagent files; entries a fork copied from its parent are left out.

usage_by_model.description: Per-model totals; keys are model ids. Same source as usage.

sidechain_usage.description: The share of usage attributable to subagents (transcript entries with isSidechain true; for kind=session, the session's subagent files).

cost_state_usage_by_model.description: For kind=session: the delta of the cost-state modelUsage over the lifetime, per model; keys are model ids. It includes calls no transcript shows, such as compaction and title generation, and is never added to usage. Absent when cost_usd is null.

cost_usd.description: For kind=session: the closing cost-state's totalCostUSD minus the cost-state the process restored at start (0 after startup or /clear; the parent's cost at the fork point for a fork). Null when that base is unknown or the lifetime was interrupted, and then the event carries no other cost-state figure; no estimate is ever written here.

cost_source.description: claude-code-estimate: Claude Code's own figure (total_cost_usd reported by claude -p, or a session lifetime's cost-state delta); price-table: computed from tokens and a price table (never for kind=session); backend: from the OTel backend or Console, which the archivist uses only for cloud spend the file tier does not hold (ADR-0006 A1). For kind=session: claude-code-estimate when cost_usd is a number, null when it is null.

duration_ms.description: For kind=session: the cost-state totalDuration delta from the restored base to the closing cost-state. In local claude -p probes it matched the time the process held this session id to within 50-900 ms: its whole uptime, unless /clear split the process into two lifetimes. In the cloud, equal-total cost-state re-writes after the closing one keep adding to totalDuration, so the delta can be shorter than the process's uptime. Null when cost_usd is null.

api_duration_ms.description: For kind=session: the cost-state totalAPIDuration delta. Null when cost_usd is null.

subagents.description: For kind=session: the larger of agent files in the lifetime's time window and Agent or Task launches.

compactions.description: For kind=session: compact_boundary entries in the lifetime.

outcome.description: Terminal state in the producer's own vocabulary: shipped, gated, no_changes, failed for runs; PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL for sprint evals; VERDICT: PASS or FAIL for gates; ended, interrupted for sessions (interrupted: no closing cost-state, so cost_usd is null).

labels.description: Free-form string labels: cynefin, loop_shape, rubric, project_type, crew_backend, permission_mode, claude_code_version, trigger (scheduled or manual).

summary.description: Optional one-line human note. Never a prompt or a response.

cost_usd.description: This model's costUSD delta over the lifetime; the per-model values add up to the event's cost_usd.

lifetime.description: kind=session only: one Claude Code process's tenure on one session id, from its start (startup, resume, fork or /clear; compaction opens nothing) to the cost-state it writes at exit, or to its last own entry when it was interrupted. cost_lineage, cum_cost_start_usd and cum_cost_end_usd are anchors for checking a lineage's continuity; they are never summed. See ADR-0006 A1.

spec.description: Version of the derivation rules, for example session-lifetime/1. Not part of event_id. Copies of one event_id are resolved in the order of ADR-0006 A1 D1.10: the higher spec, then recovered none over a recovered copy, then the more complete coverage.

anchor.description: Input to event_id: cs:<startTime>:<totalDuration> of the closing cost-state, both as decimal integers exactly as the cost-state writes them, or open:<first uuid among the lifetime's own entries> for an interrupted lifetime.

start_source.description: How the lifetime opened; --continue counts as resume.

end_reason.description: The SessionEnd reason when a hook saw it, for example clear or prompt_input_exit; none for an interrupted lifetime; null when the event was derived without the hook's payload.

started_at.description: Earliest timestamp among the lifetime's own entries, UTC.

ended_at.description: Latest timestamp among the lifetime's own entries, UTC; equal to ts.

cost_lineage.description: Anchor: the cost-state startTime in epoch milliseconds. Resumes and forks share it; /clear starts a new one. Null when no cost-state of the lineage is known. Never summed.

cum_cost_start_usd.description: Anchor: Claude Code's cumulative cost restored at the start (0 after startup or /clear; the parent's cost at the fork point for a fork). Null when unknown. Never summed.

cum_cost_end_usd.description: Anchor: totalCostUSD of the closing cost-state. Null for an interrupted lifetime. Never summed.

forked_from_session_id.description: For a fork: the parent session id when it was found; otherwise null.

cleared_from_session_id.description: For a lifetime opened by /clear: the session it cleared, when known; otherwise null.

sprint_at_start.description: Sprint context at the lifetime's start; null when no hook observed it. A value that differs from sprint flags a lifetime that spans a sprint change.

phase_at_start.description: Phase context at the lifetime's start, from .harness/sprint-state.json; null when no hook observed it.

head_at_start.description: Commit sha at the lifetime's start, when observed.

concurrent.description: True when another process appended to the same session file during this lifetime.

recovered.description: none: written live by the hooks of the process that held the lifetime; at_start: re-derived by a later SessionStart; backfill: by the backfill command; sweep: by a sweep of the transcript directory. An interrupted lifetime is always recovered. Copies of one event_id are resolved in the order of ADR-0006 A1 D1.10: the higher spec, then none over a recovered copy, then the more complete coverage.

days.description: Only for a lifetime that crosses UTC midnight: requests, tokens and cost per UTC day, two days or more; keys are YYYY-MM-DD. Tokens are binned by request timestamp. cost_usd is this day's share of the event's cost_usd: each model's cost-state cost is split across the days in proportion to the sum of that model's four token counts on each day, and a model with no transcript requests in the lifetime in proportion to all models' tokens. It apportions Claude Code's figure and is not an estimate of unpriced spend; null when the event's cost_usd is null. Day, month and window sums use these bins in place of the event's ts, never both (ADR-0006 A1 D1.10).

coverage.description: What the deriver could see for this lifetime. Rollups report these figures next to their sums.

subagent_files.description: Agent files under <session_id>/subagents/ read for this lifetime.

subagent_launches_without_file.description: Agent or Task launches in the lifetime with no agent file found.

copied_entries_excluded.description: Entries a fork copied from its parent, left out of every measure.

fork_parent.description: For a fork: whether the parent's transcript was found; not-found leaves cost_usd null. Null when the lifetime is not a fork.

context.description: Where sprint, phase and head came from: observed by a hook, read from git history, or unknown.

shortfall.description: model:key pairs where the transcript holds more tokens than the cost-state delta, for example when an interrupted predecessor's requests fell into this lifetime. Empty when none.
